dslRule:
<!id: integer.constructor.to.factory>
<!description: Replace new Integer(int) with Integer.valueOf(int). The valueOf() factory method reuses cached Integer objects for common values, leading to better performance and reduced memory footprint.>
<!severity: HINT>
new java.lang.Integer($x)
=>
java.lang.Integer.valueOf($x)
;;
summary: Replaces `new Integer(int)` with `Integer.valueOf(int)` for improved performance and adherence to modern Java practices.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
